name: print-social-blue-glass-carousel-wall-with-blurred-silhouette
title: Wall of misty-blue business carousel slides with white text cards and a blurred silhouette
whatItIs: A perspective grid of soft blue slides with headlines like 'Boost Conversion Rates', numbered idea labels, white rounded text cards and one photo slide with a man in a jacket and bold white caps, with a large blurred dark silhouette on the right.
whatItMeans: Airy and informative; white cards on foggy blue make reading easy.
techniques: Use a mist-blue gradient background on every slide.
Put the message in white rounded cards.
Present slides in perspective with a blurred foreground.
bestFor: Presentation of many slides at once

vocabulary.definition: A white block holding body copy.
A small label numbering a slide.
An out-of-focus object near the camera.
